command:
install -d -m 0700 /var/lib/etc-integrity
cat > /usr/local/sbin/etc-integrity <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

state_dir=/var/lib/etc-integrity
baseline="$state_dir/etc.baseline"

snapshot() {
    find /etc -xdev \( -type f -o -type l -o -type d \) -print | LC_ALL=C sort | while IFS= read -r path; do
        if [ -L "$path" ]; then
            meta=$(stat -c '%a|%u|%g' "$path")
            target=$(readlink "$path")
            printf 'L|%s|%s|%s\n' "$meta" "$target" "$path"
        elif [ -f "$path" ]; then
            meta=$(stat -c '%a|%u|%g|%s' "$path")
            digest=$(sha256sum "$path" | awk '{print $1}')
            printf 'F|%s|%s|%s\n' "$meta" "$digest" "$path"
        elif [ -d "$path" ]; then
            meta=$(stat -c '%a|%u|%g' "$path")
            printf 'D|%s|%s\n' "$meta" "$path"
        fi
    done
}

install_baseline() {
    tmp=$(mktemp "$state_dir/.etc.baseline.XXXXXX")
    trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
    snapshot > "$tmp"
    chmod 0600 "$tmp"
    mv -f "$tmp" "$baseline"
    trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
    printf 'Baseline written: %s (%s entries)\n' "$baseline" "$(wc -l < "$baseline")"
}

check_baseline() {
    if [ ! -r "$baseline" ]; then
        printf 'No baseline found at %s\n' "$baseline" >&2
        exit 2
    fi
    tmp=$(mktemp "$state_dir/.etc.current.XXXXXX")
    trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
    snapshot > "$tmp"
    if diff -u "$baseline" "$tmp"; then
        printf 'OK: /etc matches baseline (%s entries)\n' "$(wc -l < "$baseline")"
    else
        printf 'ALERT: /etc differs from baseline; lines prefixed - are baseline and + are current\n' >&2
        exit 1
    fi
}

case "${1:---check}" in
    --init|--update) install_baseline ;;
    --check) check_baseline ;;
    *) printf 'Usage: %s [--init|--update|--check]\n' "$0" >&2; exit 64 ;;
esac
ANTRIEB_EOF
chmod 0755 /usr/local/sbin/etc-integrity
/usr/local/sbin/etc-integrity --init
/usr/local/sbin/etc-integrity --check
